text: {"lessons":["A stock’s past price changes do not predict its next move, so I should avoid treating recent performance as a reliable signal.","Selling winning positions while adding to others can change my concentration and risk; I should base trades on my overall allocation and goals, not on gains relative to average cost.","My account fell about 9.5% from Period 1 to Period 5 despite making no trades after Period 2, so holding is not risk-free; I should review my exposure while avoiding impulsive reactions to short-term losses."]}
